test_title: PYST 7: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: If 5 October 2003 is a Sunday, then what will be the day of the week on 14 July 2010?
solution:
Given : 5 October 2003 was Sunday

Explanation :

The number of odd days from 5 October 2003 to 14 July 2010 :

 
 

 Year
 Period
 Calculation
 Odd days
 
 

 2003
 5 October 2003 - 31 December 2003
 26 October + 30 November + 31 December = 87 days
 87 ÷ 7 = 3
 
 

 2004 - 2009
 Full years (4 Ordinary years + 2 Leap years)
 (1 odd day × 4 Ordinary years) + (2 odd days × 2 Leap years) = 8 odd days
 8 ÷ 7 = 1
 
 

 2010
 1st January 2010 - 14 July 2010
 31 January + 28 February + 31 March + 30 April + 31 May + 30 June + 14 July = 195 days
 195 ÷ 7 = 6
